name: Alternate Wizard
body:
Alternate Wizard

A test class used by the browser tests. It is not a real handbook.
weapons: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows
skills: Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine and Religion

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a student of arcane magic, you have a spellbook.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day you regain some of your magical energy.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: You create pockets of relative safety within your evocations.

features.name: Portent
features.description: Glimpses of the future begin to press in on your awareness.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1.
